name: projectId
label: Process mining project
description: Selects the process mining project to be visualized.

name: diagramType
label: Type of diagram
description: Selects the initial visualization type of the diagram

name: nodePercentage
label: Activities (%)
description: Selects the percentage of most frequent activities to be visualized by default.

name: edgePercentage
label: Connections (%)
description: You can set the percentage of the most common connections to display. If you don't specify a value, it will automatically adjust to ensure at least 5 nodes are visible on the graph.

name: enableCaseFollowSimulation
label: Case follow simulation
description: Enables case follow simulation on a process graph. Simulation is displayed as animation on transition arcs with pace in relation to the arc performance.

name: diagramColorConfiguration
label: Diagram custom color configuration
description: Use this custom configuration to theme the process map component and edge information panel

name: followFilters
label: Follow filters
description: When enabled, the process map follows the filter set for the page. Toggle off to disable the filtering.

name: filterConfigurations
label: Filter Configurations
description: This property is integral to the API supported by the Filters, Dashboard, and Visualizations components developed by the PAR team. It remains hidden on both the dashboard and UI Builder, deriving its value from the page container and aligning with the filter values present on the page.

name: processGraphOrientation
label: Graph orientation
description: Define visual direction of the graph on the dashboard.

name: showNodeArcPopupActions
label: Show Node Arc popup action buttons
description: This parameter controls the action buttons that show/hide in the node/arc popup.

name: showHeader
label: Show Header
description: Switch the toggle bar to show or hide header with all header elements (title, description, filter icons)

name: headingLevel
label: Heading level
description: HTML heading tag level of the header title (H1 to H6).

name: wrapTitle
label: Wrap title
description: Wraps long titles onto a second line. If false, displays an ellipses to truncate long title.

name: showHeaderSeparator
label: Show header separator
description: Displays a line separating the header from the rest of the component.

name: description
label: Description
description: Fill in a short overview of the visualization that the end user sees.

name: showBorder
label: Show border
description: Displays a line around the component.

name: bareBorder
label: Bare
description: If true, removes padding around data visualization to provide more compact positioning on the page.
